about_the_game:
This is a music collection that features vocals (the human voice) at its core.

In addition to standard solo singing, it brings together a variety of vocal styles—such as opera, choral, and ethnic singing—to add a rich, fantastical atmosphere to your world.

The set includes up-tempo tracks inspired by battle scenes.

However, you're encouraged to use them freely in other contexts as well—action sequences, event scenes, or anywhere your creativity takes you.

Highly recommended for creators who want to experiment with incorporating vocals into background music.

Composer/Arranger: Takayuki Amanuma (X: @amanumatakayuki)

Illustration: Teruyuki Endo (X: @bluecielo_est)

■ Included Tracks

1: First Battle (Normal Battle)

2: Resound Through the Fires of War (Normal Battle)

3: A Kiss on the Crimson Rose (Normal Battle)

4: Shock and Flash (Normal Battle)

5: For the Fleeting Soul (Mid-Boss Battle)

6: Danger Zone (Mid-Boss Battle)

7: The Sword of Oath (Mid-Boss Battle)

8: Angels Dancing on the Battlefield (Mid-Boss Battle)

9: When the Sacred Bells Toll (Final Boss Battle)

10: Words Lost in the Wind (Final Boss Battle)

11: Distant Valhalla (Final Boss Battle)

12: The Hero’s Song Soars to the Sky (Final Boss Battle)

13: Victory (Battle End ME)

14: Battle Cry of Triumph (Battle End ME)

-------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
